notes:
Lead profile: small, engineering-first marketing platform building short-form social + email content generation. Inbound via webinar landing page; self-serve signup last week.

Key constraints / asks:
- High volume, cost-sensitive: expects 1.5-3M tokens/month initially, want unit cost under current vendor (they called out ~ $0.0008/token target for gen pipeline).
- Latency profile: editor UX wants median response ~300-500ms for single-turn generation; campaign job batching can be async.
- Burst capacity: marketing sends can spike (campaign sends) — needs graceful burst to ~400-500 reqs/s for 30-90s windows.
- Caching interest: very interested in prefix/KV caching to reuse brand templates and reduce per-token cost. Asked for concrete caching examples and eviction recommendations.
- Model preferences: open to quantized smaller models (7B-13B) for cost; will accept larger models for high-fidelity email variants. Wants suggestions from Redwood Optimize for quantization & batching.
- Security: SMB but wants SSO/SAML and audit logs; also asked about retention controls (default retention 30d) and opt-in longer retention for analytics team.

Quotes / call notes:
- "Cost is the single biggest blocker — we can trade a little latency for a lot less spend."
- "If you can show us 30-40% unit cost savings with batching + caching we'll move quickly."

Open items for AE/SE:
- Provide tailored quickstart with example node/python batching code and cache hints.
- Draft a short proposal for burst pricing (minutes-level bursts) and expected monthly run-rate at 2M tokens.
- Share Redwood Optimize report template and a sample quantization recommendation for a 13B model.
